subject: UN-1 — Consistent incubation conditions for reliable assay results
description: Stakeholder need: the lab requires stable incubation to trust assay results.

subject: UN-2 — Instrument available throughout an 8-hour shift
description: Stakeholder need: uptime across a full working shift.

subject: REQ-1 — Maintain sample temperature at 37 C +/- 0.5 C during incubation
description: Rationale: temperature stability drives assay validity; Source: UN-1; Acceptance criteria: temperature stays within 37 +/- 0.5 C for the full cycle.

subject: REQ-2 — Complete a standard incubation cycle within 30 minutes
description: Rationale: throughput target for shift planning; Source: UN-1; Acceptance criteria: cycle completes in <= 30 min at nominal load.

subject: REQ-3 — Achieve >= 99 percent availability across an 8-hour shift
description: Rationale: uptime supports shift throughput; Source: UN-2; Acceptance criteria: measured availability >= 99 percent over 8 h. NOTE: intentionally left with no verification link (gap).

subject: REQ-4 — Operator confirms reagent lot and expiry before each run
description: Rationale: prevents use of expired reagents; Source: UN-1; Acceptance criteria: a run cannot start until lot and expiry are confirmed.

subject: REQ-5 — Enclosure meets IEC 61010-1 protection against electric shock
description: Rationale: operator safety and regulatory compliance; Source: (none — intentionally unsourced orphan); Acceptance criteria: passes IEC 61010-1 inspection.

subject: REQ-6 — Control software logs each run quickly and presents it in a user-friendly way
description: Rationale: operators need accessible run history; Source: UN-1; Acceptance criteria: (none). NOTE: intentionally vague wording ('quickly', 'user-friendly') and no verification (quality smell + gap).

subject: TC-1 — Temperature-stability test
description: Verifies REQ-1 by measuring chamber temperature across a full cycle.

subject: TC-2 — Cycle-time test
description: Verifies REQ-2 by timing a standard incubation cycle at nominal load.

subject: TC-3 — Operator lot-confirmation walkthrough
description: Demonstrates REQ-4 via an operator walkthrough of the pre-run check.

subject: TC-4 — Data-export format test
description: Tests a data-export format. NOTE: intentionally traces to no requirement (unrequested downstream work).

subject: RC-1 — Over-temperature cutoff
description: Risk control for REQ-1: a hardware cutoff prevents reagent degradation on over-temperature.
